# India Macro Indicators & Economic Monitor

> Official and independent monitor for Indian macroeconomic indicators, banking system liquidity, monetary policy anchors, and macroeconomic research.

## Core Capabilities
- Real-time tracking of Reserve Bank of India (RBI) repo rate, SDF, and MSF corridor anchors.
- Systemic banking liquidity deficit / surplus monitoring via CCIL and RBI WSS feeds.
- Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Wholesale Price Index (WPI) headline vs core inflation prints.
- Foreign Exchange (Forex) reserve health and import cover metrics.
- Macroeconomic Release Calendar with official publishing frequencies and statutory release windows.
- Full research analyses covering monetary policy, fiscal deficits, liquidity management, and sovereign debt.

## Key Sections & Canonical URLs
- **Homepage & Indicator Monitor**: `/`
  Real-time tracking of all active macro indicators with category filters, frequency selectors, delta changes, and target anchors.
- **Macroeconomic Release Calendar**: `/calendar`
  Official schedules for RBI MPC decisions, CPI inflation releases, GDP quarterly prints, Index of Industrial Production (IIP), and Forex WSS announcements.
- **Direct CSV Data Feed**: `/data/metrics.csv`
  Official comma-separated dataset containing all verified Indian macroeconomic parameters.

## Official Data Verification Sources
- Reserve Bank of India (RBI): https://www.rbi.org.in
- Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI): https://www.mospi.gov.in
- Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL): https://www.ccilindia.com
- Ministry of Finance, Government of India: https://finmin.nic.in
